translations.web: “ ‘They shall not shave their heads or shave off the corners of their beards or make any cuttings in their flesh.
translations.bsb: Priests must not make bald spots on their heads, shave off the edges of their beards, or make cuts in their bodies.
translations.kjv: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
translations.asv: They shall not make baldness upon their head, neither shall they shave off the corner of their beard, nor make any cuttings in their flesh.
